name: Swearing
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor God's name and avoid taking it in vain, emphasizing the seriousness of swearing (Exodus 20:7). Jesus teaches not to swear oaths lightly or at all, highlighting the purity of speech expected from His followers (Matthew 5:33-34). Every idle or careless word carries eternal consequences, as all will give account on the day of judgment (Matthew 12:36). The heart's condition is revealed through speech, and Christians are called to use words that build up and minister grace rather than corrupt communication (Luke 6:45; Ephesians 4:29).
